passage.label: Except believed righteous deeds advised each other truth advised each other patience

arabicExcerpts.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ

mainSubject.label: The exception: those who have believed, done righteous deeds, advised one another to truth and advised one another to patience

subordinateSubjects.label: Except those who believed, did righteous deeds, advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Four-fold rescue condition: belief, righteous deeds, mutual truth-counsel, mutual patience-counsel

relationships.label: Mutual counsel toward truth and patience as communal obligations completing individual faith and deeds

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the universal-loss declaration (2) before the four-fold exception opens (3); P2 is the single-verse exception comprising belief, righteous deeds, mutual truth-counsel and mutual patience-counsel.
